mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was most worthwhile: it showed that the colon recovers water and that its cells can use some molecules made by bacteria.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was straightforward but didn't reveal much beyond the picture of a layer covering the lining.

surprise.text: I was surprised that bacteria make gas as well as small fatty acids from some fibre, and that lining cells can use some of their products.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless: even the only-offered steps had clear places in building and fitting the wall.

continue.text: I'd choose to continue for another chapter to see more connections between body systems. The bacteria-and-lining connection made me curious, even though some fitting steps were predictable.
